_: Routes that write by a caller-supplied key and never mention the org.
Every entry needs a reason. status=safe means the id is a credential in
its own right; status=known-open means the sweep is right and the fix is
still owed — those are printed loudly and never quietly pass as correct.
Keyed by route, not by line: line numbers shift under any edit.

DELETE /api/v1/2fa.why: two_factor_secrets is keyed by user, not by organization, and the user is the authenticated caller.

GET /api/v1/ads/accounts/callback/:platf.why: The row is deleted by the one-time OAuth state value the callback carries, which is the credential; an org column would add nothing to it.

GET /api/v1/assets/download.why: The download token in the query is the credential; processDownload resolves the delivery from it before writing.

GET /api/v1/email-identities/confirm/:to.why: The signed token in the path is the credential and names who it is for; it is verified before the write, so there is no caller-supplied id to scope.

GET /public/forms/:formId/variant.why: The form or survey id IS the public identifier — it is embedded on the customer site — and the write is that object own counter. Audit category C.

GET /public/forms/:id/view.why: The form or survey id IS the public identifier — it is embedded on the customer site — and the write is that object own counter. Audit category C.
